exposure: Periconceptional folic acid (FA) supplementation (timing of initiation: no use, after last menstrual period, 1-2 months before last menstrual period, 3+ months before last menstrual period)
cohort: The study included 201,477 women aged 18-49 who participated in the NFPHEP from 2010-2018 and had a singleton livebirth in 129 counties in southwest China.
finding: Periconceptional supplementation with folic acid was associated with a lower risk of preterm birth, with the greatest reduction observed in women who started taking FA at least 3 months before their last menstrual period.
gest_age: Preterm birth defined as < 37 weeks, early preterm birth as < 34 weeks
